# Chess England

> Chess England runs FIDE- and ECF-rated chess tournaments across London and beyond — rapid, blitz and weekend congresses — organised by Adam Raoof. New events are announced through The Chess Circuit newsletter.

## What we offer
- FIDE- and ECF-rated tournaments: rapid, blitz and standard-play congresses
- Events for all levels, from improvers to titled players, with graded sections
- Junior-friendly events, some with dedicated junior sections

## Where we play
- Golders Green, London — rapid and blitz
- Muswell Hill (The Clissold Arms, London N2 9HR) — rapid, standard and congress
- Hendon, London — monthly FIDE-rated evening blitz
- Northampton — weekend FIDE congresses
- Occasional international trips (Ghent, Rotterdam)

## Stay updated
- The Chess Circuit newsletter: https://chesscircuit.substack.com
